subject.title: fix(automation): bind merge proof to exact PR state

question: Should post-flight hard-reject fix reports whose merge_preflight was not generated for the exact live PR head and base immediately after this PR lands?
rationale: The code direction is sound, but the fail-closed upgrade behavior can block older active artifacts and should be accepted intentionally by the automation owner.

options.title: Accept fail-closed binding
options.body: Merge with the expectation that older unbound or drifted reports block and are regenerated against live state.

options.title: Add compatibility messaging
options.body: Before merge, add a clearer blocked-report reason or temporary compatibility note for pre-existing unbound artifacts.

options.title: Wait for canary proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a ProjectClownfish canary produces a bound merge_preflight and post-flight consumes it successfully.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed binding
recommendation.body: Merge with the expectation that older unbound or drifted reports block and are regenerated against live state.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent path history and this PR both point to vincentkoc as the owner of the executor/post-flight merge-gate behavior.
